caseName: Newark Teachers Union v. Board of Education
caseNameFull: Newark Teachers Union v. Board of Education of Newark

opinions.text:
Super. Ct. N. J. Motion of American Civil Liberties Union for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion to dispense with printing petitioners' reply brief granted. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted and case set for oral argument.
